The Sunday Kickoff

Tempe, AZ · Road · Social

The Sunday Kickoff is a road and social group ride in Tempe, AZ. It rolls every Sunday at 7:30 am from Varies each week around the East Valley. The Sept 27, 2026 start was the Panera Bread at the SE corner of Guadalupe and McClintock.. About 25-30 (less in summer) miles, social pace, typically 15-17 mph.

For visitors

Visitors are always welcome. A helmet is required and earphones are not allowed. Anyone much faster or slower than the group should plan to handle their own navigation. Look up the week's start on the RideWithGPS calendar; RSVP is optional. Contact: rideleaders@pmbcaz.org (put the ride name in the subject).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15-17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Sunday Kickoff group ride

PMBC's Sunday social road ride around the East Valley, 25 to 30 miles at 15 to 17 mph, with breakfast after. The start moves from week to week and is posted by Thursday. The club says visitors are always welcome.
